name: Urabrask
aliases: the praetor of the Quiet Furnace
description: Urabrask is the Phyrexian praetor of the Quiet Furnace, who leads the red-aligned faction of New Phyrexia and refuses to serve Elesh Norn.

summary.text: Urabrask is the Phyrexian praetor of the Quiet Furnace, who leads the red-aligned faction of New Phyrexia and refuses to serve Elesh Norn.

bio.text: He is the one praetor who does not take part in compleating the captured Mirran angel Atraxa alongside Elesh Norn and the others.

bio.text: On New Capenna, Tezzeret leads Vivien to the wounded Urabrask in a cavern below the city, where Urabrask says he serves no one, will not give Norn the Quiet Furnace, and will lead a challenge to her control.

citations.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien that others like them are present and that his employer is acquiring Halo with other goals, and invites her to meet Urabrask.
timeline.quote: "Good, come along then. Urabrask will be eager to meet you."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret leads Vivien to a wounded Phyrexian, Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, in a cavern below the city.
timeline.quote: "Vivien, meet Urabrask," Tezzeret said.

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask accuses Tezzeret of betraying him, and Tezzeret says he has brought a new ally.
timeline.quote: "You betrayed me," Urabrask hissed to Tezzeret.

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
timeline.quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for the recovering Urabrask in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and learns the Planar Bridge wounded him.
timeline.quote: "You have a deal."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
timeline.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien declines to bring Elspeth to Urabrask yet, promising to share information when she has more, and leaves.
timeline.quote: "When I have something worthwhile."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Urabrask she found Elspeth; Urabrask says she is the key and he will wait for her, her spark igniting his people and the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "She is the key to our success."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Elspeth of Urabrask's planned revolution on New Phyrexia, and they decide to take the Halo and the news to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "Dominaria." Elspeth turned away from the city skyline of New Capenna.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien reveals that Urabrask opposes Elesh Norn, who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to expand her dominion at once.
timeline.quote: That Elesh Norn, a rival praetor, has nearly unified New Phyrexia under her banner,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: In the Darksteel Eye, Tezzeret sees vast Phyrexian legions assembling but cannot view Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.
timeline.quote: he discovered that two locations managed to defy the eye's intrusion.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jace explains that Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, tolerates the Mirrans and his chaos may be the key to success.
timeline.quote: Urabrask is the praetor of the Quiet Furnace.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias reveals a new Reality Chip and says he knows of Urabrask and the Mirran attacks and will let them unfold.
timeline.quote: There is no violating an agreement already broken.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains the guarded pathways and why he helps, saying he serves no one.
timeline.quote: Urabrask serves no one.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
timeline.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn has Urabrask dismembered and Karn brought before her to witness her celebration over shackled Mirrans.
timeline.quote: With another snap she dismisses Urabrask—the centurions chop him into quarters and carry him off.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Urabrask's red-aligned Phyrexian faction allows Mirrodin's citizens safe harbor.
timeline.quote: Its red-aligned faction, led by Urabrask, turns a blind eye to the citizens of Mirrodin, allowing them safe harbor.
